fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Only enabled rows take part in approval resolution.

fields.label: Priority
fields.description: Higher priority rows win; ties go to the more specific row.

fields.label: Tool
fields.description: Optional reviewed tool name, for example create_document. Empty matches every tool.

fields.label: Target DocType
fields.description: Optional: match only calls that target this DocType.

fields.label: Operation
fields.options:
Any
Read
Create
Update
Delete
Submit
Report
fields.description: Matched against the tool's declared operation class.

fields.label: Role
fields.description: Optional: match only run owners who hold this role.

fields.label: Amount Condition
fields.options:
Any amount
At or below limit
Above limit
fields.description: Amounts are compared by magnitude as raw numbers; no currency conversion.

fields.label: Amount Limit
fields.description: Required when the amount condition is not Any amount.

fields.label: Currency
fields.description: Informational only: name the limit's currency in the reason; resolution never converts.

fields.label: Decision
fields.description: Auto-approve and Deny record the same audit trail as a human decision.

fields.label: Reason
fields.description: Optional explanation shown with the automatic decision.
